name: @nakamiri/kiro-cli-plugin-cc
description: Use Kiro CLI from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

scripts.//test:macos: Platform-specific suites, kept out of `test` (and so out of CI) on purpose: they assert the ps-based pid probe that only runs where there is no /proc. Run them on a macOS machine.
scripts.//test:concurrency: Capped at 4 on purpose. node:test defaults to one worker per CPU, and the process-level suites spawn real supervisors and children; oversubscribed, assertions about what a signal did or did not reach began failing about once per run, a different one each time. At 4 the suite is stable and no slower in practice.
